Repo-level .nuget/packages.config declares NUnit.Runners 2.6.4, but no NUnit test files exist anywhere in the repo -- the only test project (GildedRose.Tests) is xUnit-only. Likely a stale/unused build-tooling dependency from repo history.

GildedRose.Tests.csproj has no ProjectReference or assembly Reference to GildedRose.Console, and its single test (TestTheTruth) asserts Assert.True(true). The UpdateQuality() business logic in Program.cs has zero automated test coverage.

UpdateQuality() (Program.cs:37-111) is a single ~75-line method with deeply nested conditionals (up to 6 levels) and string-literal item-name comparisons used as the dispatch mechanism ('Aged Brie', 'Sulfuras, Hand of Ragnaros', 'Backstage passes to a TAFKAL80ETC concert') instead of a type/strategy abstraction. This is the canonical Gilded Rose kata anti-pattern -- high cyclomatic complexity concentrated in one method, no polymorphism over Item.
